about_the_game:
English Boost - Learn English While Living Your Life

Stop postponing English.
English Boost works in the background and helps you expand your vocabulary without setting aside “study time.”

Play games. Work. Watch shows.
Words appear over any application - and gradually stick in your memory.

🚀 Passive Learning with a Smart Overlay

Display selected word groups in any corner of your screen.
They rotate automatically while you stay focused on what you’re doing.

No cramming.
No timers.
No pressure.

You just see the words regularly - your brain handles the rest.

🎯 Active Flashcard Training

Want faster results? Launch a training session.

  • Correct answer: +1

  • Wrong answer: -1

  • The system tracks your performance

  • Difficult words appear more often

No randomness - only focused repetition where it matters.

🧠 Smart Repetition System

  • Mastered words gradually disappear

  • Difficult words return more frequently

  • Balanced mix of new and review

You don’t waste time on what you already know.

⚙️ Fully Customizable

  • Thematic sets: travel, food, family, work, and more

  • Create your own word lists

  • Adjust display frequency

  • Choose overlay position

You learn exactly what you need.

📊 Transparent Progress Tracking

Track your results:

  • Words mastered

  • Progress per category

  • Overall statistics

What You Get

✅ Vocabulary growth without dedicated study time
✅ Systematic repetition without overload
✅ A background tool that doesn’t interrupt your workflow
✅ Full control over your learning process
✅ Real progress instead of “I’ll start on Monday”

Who It’s For

  • People tired of boring courses

  • Anyone spending long hours at a computer

  • Learners who want efficiency without pressure

  • Those who value practical results

Important Notice

Translations may contain occasional inaccuracies.

Alternative pronunciation transcriptions may not fully reflect real-world pronunciation due to various factors, including accent differences and phonetic variations.

For accurate pronunciation, it is recommended to rely on the original International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) transcription.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Learn English passively - while gaming, working, or studying! A smart overlay shows words on top of any application - whether it's a match, a quest, or a work task. Just glance at the words and memorize them without breaking your focus.
supported_languages: Russian, English, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, French, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian
